candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that increases mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender] by lpUnits.
Credit lpUnits to the member key instead of the pool (msg.sender) key in mapSynth_LPBalance.
Add the minted amount instead of the added LP units to mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender].
Remove the onlyPool modifier so any caller can invoke mintSynth and mutate mapSynth_LPBalance.
Delete the statement that updates mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] in mintSynth, so the synth debt is never recorded.
Replace the debt update with a plain assignment so each mintSynth call overwrites rather than accumulates the pool's synth debt.
Attribute the synth debt to the member address instead of the calling pool address.
Remove the require check in the onlyPool modifier so any address, not just curated pools, can call mintSynth and alter mapSynth_LPDebt.
